title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Cozmoslabs…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Cozmoslabs TranslatePress through version 3.3.9. This flaw involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing an attacker with low privileges to inject malicious scripts that execute in the context of other users. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.5.
